Morning Prayer Seed 5/27/2026

Prayer Request 5/27/2026:

Members, what a pleasure it has been continuously working with each one of you on an individual and team level.

I'm asking for a prayer request surrounding our ministry, my work, and life updates I hope to be sharing here soon that God has been developing and building up since about 1 year of progress where I've come up in my walk with His grace.

I'm going to be tapering off from the very heavy labor intensive tasks and taking a break here soon and would love it that God provides me an opportunity to serve Him in more ways to grow His kingdom.

I would like to extend a very special and warm welcome to our admin team who have been hard at work making sure this ministry is possible, bringing you consistent content, and timely events where we could fellowship: @Vanessa_mind @Davy_Lep 🙏PRAYER DOG🙏 Edward thank you for all your hard work and may God bless you to continue serving guided by His Holy Spirit!
Let’s keep praying for David my friends 🙏🏻 he’s going through a real spiritual battle and Satan will try everything he can to stop David from serving effectively but God will prevail!
In Jesus name rebuke the enemy from his life!
Remember how powerful prayer is, and every prayer counts!
Thank you for the prayers, God is good, feeling better ❤️
SEED MORNING PRAYER 5/28/2026

Prayer Request 5/28/2026:

I would like to put in a prayer request because I will be having a special meeting with vice president of Gideon's International in regards to our ministry so God blesses our discussion and produces fruitful results. 

I also will be meeting with pastors at my home church afterwards and we will be discussing intimate details, so I would also appreciate that our personal conversation would be glorifying to Jesus

I need prayers, whatever you can give. Prayers so I can endure hardships, Prayers so I can keep carrying this cross. Prayers so I can keep serving y'all, this ministry. That the lord may establish me, that my body can keep up this race. That I can stay awake, instead of sleeping in sorrow. I need Jesus. That I can be made fit for the kingdom of God. Its hard to ask for help, to ask for prayers. But I need them rn. 

I need help through the spiritual battles I face, that I am not alone.

I have nothing else but Jesus and this ministry to lean on. Reminders that the hardships I face is just refinement, I am being made perfect, that I am gaining endurance and hope that doesn't put me to shame. 

That whatever may happen to me, all thing work to the good of those who believe.

To have the full armor against the enemy. Pray for me.
Quote Scripture brother, drive the enemy to his knees before our God and cast your sorrows onto Jesus for your redemption from this unequal yoke.

Hey yall I did leg and back day at the gym yesterday, I haven’t gone to the gym in forever, annnnd today I feel like a cripple and I have a throbbing headache. I ask for prayer of healing over these things. And also that I would feel pushed to read my Bible and pray more.

I also want prayer that my friend, Ethan, would feel Gods love and hope in his life. Pray that he would feel more motivated to pray and also read his Bible, as I know we all need more encouragement for too.

I also would like yall to pray for my other friend who’s coming down with a flu, and just that Gods will would be done in His life and that God would continue to change his heart.

Pray also for my friend Hassla in London. God knows she’s going through a lot mentally and related to relationships. May God save her from that and that she would accept Gods ways for her.

Thank you guys 🙏🏻

Prayer Request 5/31/2026:

I'm asking for a prayer request this morning for God's wisdom and guidance of the Holy Spirit where I'll be at today to protect me from making any mistakes and allowing His will to be done.

I've been worried to follow through with this action and afraid of the consequences it may carry but last time I did something similar it introduced a huge blessing into my life so I'll ask God's hand in this likewise.

Hey guys can yall pray for Brandon’s brother Daniel? He’s going through a terrible sickness (apparently it’s the “new virus” going around) he said he feels like he’s dying. So prayer for healing over that. Thank you all

Testimony:

Some lady just walked up to me on the sidewalk and asked me what the time was so I told her it's 11:48, she then shared with me that her car and her phone were stolen and I said, "Do you need a Bible?", she said, " Yes, I would like that", that I reached into my car grabbed her Bible said it's the last copy I have and she told me her name is Anna. I said that I'll pray for her and she said she'll pray for me too.
Prayer for Wed Morning

Testimony:

So the girl named Ashley, that I prayed for at work, that Jesus put in my heart to ask her what her prayer need was.

Today I walked into work and she was in front of me, we greeted each other and I gifted her a Bible. Jesus is so good y'all! Just as He promised her!

She gave me consent to share this with all of you and she also mentioned to pray for Mark, for her kids, and grandkids. So please pray you have an opportunity. 🙏PRAYER DOG🙏 for visibility
